methodologyNotes: Prices sourced from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. monthlyUsd reflects the effective per-seat cost for one user at the entry quota. Where annual-only billing is published, annualized monthly rate is used and month-to-month rate noted. Quote-only and enterprise tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd=null. Splunk On-Call's official pricing URL returned 404; pricing sourced from softwareadvice.com (2026-06-14) and noted in provenance. Blameless was acquired by FireHydrant (301 redirect confirmed 2026-06-14) and is not listed as a separate vendor. Opsgenie is end-of-sale as of 2025-06-04 per Atlassian announcement but included because existing subscriptions continue until 2027-04-05.
